paragraphs: An AI-powered resume feedback app. Upload your resume (optionally with a job description) and get an overall score, an ATS-optimisation score, a skills and missing-skills breakdown, and matching job recommendations.
Built as Spring Boot microservices behind an API Gateway, with a React + Vite frontend.
The backend runs on free hosting tiers, which put idle services to sleep. The first request after a quiet period can take about a minute while services wake up. See Free-tier behaviour.
features: Sign in with Google (OAuth2) or email + password with OTP email verification
Resume upload (PDF, DOC, DOCX, up to 2 MB) with an optional job description
AI analysis with Google Gemini: overall score, ATS-optimisation score, summary, skills, missing skills
Live progress: analysis runs in the background and the page shows its status as it moves along
